science.title: Probiotics that actually reach your gut
science.text: Most probiotics get destroyed by stomach acid before they do anything. Bacillus Coagulans is different — it's spore-forming, so it survives the journey and reaches your gut alive. We pair 10 billion CFU of it with a protease, papain and bromelain enzyme blend that helps break food down, then deliver it all in a berry strip that dissolves on your tongue.

items.q: Do I need water to take it?
items.a: No — the strip dissolves on your tongue in seconds. Take it anywhere, no water and no pill to swallow.
Yes. The strips are plant-based (pullulan), sweetened with monk fruit and stevia, with no gelatin or animal products.
A spore-forming probiotic that's hardy enough to survive stomach acid and reach your gut alive, where it supports a balanced microbiome — 10 billion CFU per strip.
Once a day, ideally around a meal. Consistency matters more than exact timing for gut balance — most people notice steadier digestion over a few weeks.
